newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's Summers lauds Russian debt rating.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's Summers lauds Russian debt rating.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers on Monday said the assignment of ratings to Russian debt was a very positive development.
"It's a very encouraging development and a testament to the progress that Russia has made in reforming and stabilising its economy," Summers said.
"There's a lot more to do, but there's been a lot of progress," he said.
Earlier on Monday Moody's Investors Service Inc assigned a Ba2 rating to Russia's long-term foreign currency debt, while S&P rated the country's long-term sovereign debt at BB-minus.
European rating agency IBCA gave Russia its highest rating, assigning a BB-plus to the long-term foreign currency.
Summers declined to comment on the dollar's strength in the foreign exchange market.
